purpose: The patch modifies device‑property fwnode helper APIs so they accept an ERR_PTR as a valid argument. Callers no longer need separate NULL/ERR_PTR checks before passing the handle, reducing the chance of missing the error case.
Updates the QCOM QMP PHY device‑tree binding header to correct the child‑node description, changing it from “one node per lane” to “one node per PHY”, fixing the documentation.
Adds the initial code structures in the AMD display driver (DC) needed to support Firmware Assisted Memory Switching, preparing the driver for the future FAMS feature.

The patch adds #ifdef guards around two lines in drm/ttm that assume real x86 hardware, preventing compilation errors when building the kernel for the user‑mode Linux (ARCH=um) configuration, which can be selected by randconfig.
Adds const qualifiers to pointers of struct qcom_icc_bcm in the Qualcomm SC8280XP interconnect driver, indicating they are never modified and improving code safety without changing runtime behavior.
Fixes incorrect handling of 64‑bit arguments in SBI PMU calls when compiled for 32‑bit RISC‑V, ensuring proper register usage.

The commit updates the perf cpumap code to replace direct accesses to the CPU map with calls to the perf_cpu_map library API, improving reference‑count handling and making BPF code use the CPU identifier consistently.

Adds DMA allocation tracepoints, refactors alloc/free paths to use a single tracepoint, and includes the real allocating function name in the trace for better debugging of misuse such as freeing before unmapping.

The driver split cs42l42 probe() into three stages and added an init_done flag to avoid register accesses when initialization failed, enabling proper handling for SoundWire where register access must wait for enumeration.
Adds a device‑tree node for the Data Capture and Compare (DCC) hardware on the Qualcomm SC7280 ARM64 platform, providing its register address so the kernel can recognize and use the device.

Adjusts iwlwifi driver code to de‑const variables correctly, using uintptr_t casts instead of void* casts and removing unnecessary casts for dma_map_single, enabling compilation on stricter compilers.
Refactors the s390/vfio-ap driver to obtain queue devices via the AP bus's ap_get_qdev() hashtable lookup instead of iterating over the device list, improving lookup efficiency.

Fixes NFSv4.2 client handling of zero‑length CLONE when a delegation is held; previously the inode size was set to zero due to an optimization that skipped GETATTR. The patch computes the correct size from the server's GETATTR response.
Adds a macro/function to extract Signal‑to‑Noise Ratio from the wcn36xx BD PHY descriptor, enabling future use in mac80211 survey operations.
The patch changes RAID5 stripe_head handling to call bio_init for full bios initialization instead of a partial setup followed by manual field assignments and bio_reset.
Removes an unnecessary backslash at the end of a line in the spr_cstates[] array definition within intel_idle, cleaning up the source.

Adds CONFIG_OBJTOOL Kconfig option, makes stack validation optional for objtool, and replaces most CONFIG_STACK_VALIDATION uses with CONFIG_OBJTOOL, clarifying CONFIG_STACK_VALIDATION as frame-pointer specific while keeping CONFIG_UNWINDER_ORC unchanged.
The patch changes the driver’s code to use the __le32 type instead of plain u32 for fields and casts, correcting endianness mismatches reported by the Sparse static analyzer.
The commit corrects a spelling mistake in the SCSI subsystem documentation, updating the relevant doc file.
Updates the i.MX fractional‑N GPPLL clock driver to program the MFD register with 1 instead of 0, complying with the hardware specification that disallows a zero value.
Fixes hwpoison handling: when a page is already poisoned, kill_accessing_process() now returns -EHWPOISON, preventing wrong "Memory error not recovered" messages and duplicate SIGBUS signals.
Updates the device-tree binding documentation for the SNVS LPGPR driver to note that i.MX8M compatible strings include a fallback "fsl,imx7d-snvs-lpgpr" entry, matching the driver’s expectations.
The patch deletes a dev_err() call in the aspeed SPI driver because devm_ioremap_resource() already logs errors, eliminating duplicate messages.

The commit adds handling for multicast router (mrouter) ports in the sparx5 Ethernet driver, ensuring such ports are automatically included in all active multicast groups and that their traffic is forwarded even when flooding is disabled.
Renames the struct xilinx_pcie_port to xilinx_pcie to follow the <driver>_pcie naming convention, with no functional impact.
Removes a verbose debug print from the Qualcomm QMP combo PHY init operation, cleaning up kernel log output.
The commit updates the device‑tree binding files for the GPIO IR LED (gpio‑ir‑tx) driver, converting the existing description to the new DT schema format used for bindings.
The patch modifies SUNRPC's unx_lookup_cred() to use the same mempool allocation strategy as rpc_malloc(), correcting an improper allocation method.
Adds entries for the CRD and Lenovo Thinkpad X13s to the sc8280xp device‑tree binding file, extending the list of valid compatible strings.
Adds a device‑tree node for the ethqos Ethernet controller on Qualcomm SM8150, correcting interrupt numbers and adding its power‑domain.
The patch replaces a hard‑coded literal 9 in the block subsystem with the macro PAGE_SECTORS_SHIFT and removes an unnecessary cast, making the code clearer and relying on the compiler for conversion.

The patch changes the s390 DASD driver’s sysfs setup to use kobj_type's default_groups field instead of the older default_attrs field, following the API introduced in commit aa30f47c, and prepares removal of the deprecated default_attrs.

The patch updates the i915 driver DVO enable/disable code to use the generic intel_de_rmw() helper instead of a custom read‑modify‑write implementation and switches the posting read to intel_de_posting_read().
Removes the duplicate hisilicon,hi6220-reset device tree binding because the related controllers are already documented in other binding files.
The commit reverts a previous addition of pipe1 hardware support because it caused graphics hangs on Navi 21 with GNOME Wayland, restoring the prior kernel state.
Adds a small driver‑specific struct to hold the __iomem pointer, fixing sparse static‑analysis warnings about address‑space mismatched pointer conversions in the hisi PCI driver.

Extends the CRIU PROCESS_INFO ioctl in the amdkfd driver to report the number of SVM ranges and their total private data size for a KFD process, enabling discovery of these ranges for checkpoint/restore.
Adds a new boolean flag in the i915 GuC driver to explicitly track whether command submission has been initialized, replacing the previous reliance on the now-removed LRC descriptor pool.

The patch corrects the calculation of relocation range limits for RISC‑V PC‑relative jumps using auipc+jalr, fixing an overflow error where offsets near ±2^31 were mis‑handled due to the 0x800 adjustment.
Adds a check for the return value of clk_enable() in the davinci_mmc driver and returns an error if it fails, improving robustness.
Adds missing asterisks in comment blocks of trace_events_hist.c to correct malformed comment lines and eliminate clang warnings.

The patch enlarges the static _name_ array in the Exynos MCT driver from length 10 to a larger size so that each CPU’s local timer interrupt can have its mct_tick value printed correctly, addressing a scalability limitation.

The commit corrects KVM PPC migration hang by adjusting the decrementer expiry initialization to be relative to the guest timebase, matching the new relative semantics and preventing an oversized decrementer after migration.
The patch modifies F2FS to retain io_flags on the bio structure, preventing I/O splitting when different op_flags exist in two fio holders, thus allowing proper merging of I/O requests.
Refactors mm/gup's compound_range_next() to drop a redundant order check and replace PageCompound() with PageHead(), simplifying logic and improving performance.

The patch removes the HAL_DEF_IS_SUPPORT_ANT_DIV case from GetHalDefVar8188EUsb() in the r8188eu driver and moves that logic into a new function, continuing the effort to eliminate the legacy HAL layer.

The patch corrects how the Display Stream Compression (DSC) bits_per_pixel value is written to the DPU register. It aligns the driver with the 6.4 fixed‑point format used by hardware, removing incorrect integer‑only handling copied from another source.
The commit changes the perf test suite by replacing the record test workload with the thloop program, eliminating the need for a compiler during testing.
Ensures hci_cmd_sync_queue returns an error when HCI_UNREGISTER is set, preventing commands from being queued after the device is unregistered and avoiding a use‑after‑free.
Adds a likely() compiler hint to ICE_XDP_REDIR at the ice_run_xdp_zc() call site to improve branch prediction and generated code efficiency for XDP redirect handling.
The patch adds logic to invalidate unresolved unicast neighbour entries for broadcast addresses when a matching broadcast route is added, preventing stale entries that cause packet drops.
Removes an unnecessary asm/termios.h include from n_hdlc.c, relying on linux/tty.h which already provides the needed termios definitions, simplifying the include hierarchy.
The patch changes the sdhci-brcmstb driver by declaring brcmstb_reset static, removing a -Wmissing-prototypes compiler warning.
The commit deletes unused guest PASID UAPI interfaces and related definitions from the IOMMU subsystem because they are not referenced and will be superseded by a new iommufd design.
Adds proper error handling after mmc_add_host() in the moxart MMC driver, freeing the allocated host on failure to avoid memory leak and kernel crash.
The patch replaces the use of __umoddi3 with the kernel helper div_u64_rem in the AMD GPU driver, fixing an undefined symbol error that prevented 32‑bit i386 builds.

The patch modifies the MSCC MACsec driver to stop copying encryption keys when a flow is freed, relying on the earlier change that cleared keys. By avoiding the copy, it removes unnecessary handling of secret material.
The patch changes the memory allocation in vhost/vsock from kmalloc to kvmalloc/kvfree for large packet buffers (≈32 KB) to avoid allocation failures observed during SFTP over vsock.

The driver for the DP83822 Ethernet controller disables the receive‑error interrupt because the RCSR register can fill up on cable disconnect, causing an interrupt flood. Since the driver never reads/clears RCSR, the fix simply turns off that interrupt to stop the flood.
Updates the RISC‑V Microchip device‑tree bindings by adding a compatible string for the Aries Embedded M100PFSEVP SOM/EVK platform, documenting its support for kernel DT usage.

Implements runtime creation and freeing of DSP audio paths in the Intel AVS ASoC driver, converting topology templates into concrete paths during hw_params and releasing them on hw_free, with dynamic ID allocation based on firmware limits.
Adds a mandatory TLB flush after updating page table mappings for AMD VG20 GPUs with XGMI bridges, addressing stalls caused by stale PTEs cached in the translation cache.
Adds support for Allwinner H616 USB PHY by defining a new configuration structure that captures its specific quirks and registers a new compatible string, enabling the driver to handle this SoC.
Adds support for the IVO M133NW4J-R3 eDP panel by creating a new panel entry in drm/panel-edp, using generic timing parameters due to missing documentation.
The patch renames the KVM self‑test file 'evmcs_test' to 'hyperv_evmcs', adding the 'hyperv' prefix and dropping the redundant '_test' suffix to match other Hyper‑V emulation tests.
The patch adds the static keyword to the I2C and SPI of_match tables in the Arizona MFD driver, correcting their visibility after they were split and were unintentionally exported.
Adds infrastructure for KPP template instances: defines struct kpp_instance, registration function, helper accessors, and documentation, enabling future template-based KPP algorithms.

The patch reorders code in the i.MX RNG driver: it clears the IRQ mask first, then registers the IRQ handler. This prevents handling a SEED_DONE interrupt from a previous boot stage that would otherwise complete the RNG operation early and crash the kernel during boot.

The commit removes unnecessary supply and clock description entries from the Qualcomm QMP PHY device‑tree binding files, as these descriptions add no value beyond what the resource names already convey.
Updates device-tree binding documentation for AD7923/AD7924 ADCs, noting AD7927's compatibility with the AD7928 driver and clarifying that AD7923 and AD7924 share the same driver behavior.
The commit raises the maximum LED brightness for the Dream Cheeky USB notifier to 63 by adjusting a constant in the hid-led driver, based on empirical testing.
Adds proper handling for invalid-size PCI config read requests in the mvebu driver by setting the read value to all‑ones and returning PCIBIOS_BAD_REGISTER_NUMBER, matching the write path.
The commit deletes a custom bit_reverse() implementation and replaces its uses with the kernel-provided bitrev8() plus bitshift, eliminating duplicated code in the packing library.

The commit reorders initialization on LoongArch by flushing the TLB right after setting up the page‑table walker and before any page allocation, and moves a unrelated pgtable bits define call into tlb_init, to stop stale TLB entries that cause the second kernel after kexec/kdump to fail to boot on SMP systems.

Adds a cache for the last b+tree path used during fiemap extent‑sharedness checks in Btrfs, preventing repeated traversals of the same nodes when scanning many extents, thus reducing metadata lookups and speeding up fiemap.
Updates perf c2c documentation to include the newly added 'N/A' store metric in the report table, reflecting a change in metric definitions.

The patch moves the definitions of mach_get_rtc_pll, mach_set_rtc_pll and mach_hwclk into the same source file (time.c) for nommu m68k builds, ensuring they are compiled only when needed and eliminating undefined reference errors when the generic RTC driver is enabled.
Adds code to release enclosure device objects when the mpi3mr driver is unloaded and before rescanning devices on controller reset, ensuring proper cleanup of allocated resources.
Fixes race and double‑free bugs in hugetlb VMA lock handling during VMA split and range unmapping, and ensures a lock is allocated for all VM_MAYSHARE vmas.

The patch relaxes the restriction that prevents a vforked child (sharing the parent's memory) from moving to a different time namespace; after exec the new mm allows the switch, so the kernel now permits timens change on vfork+exec without adding a new clone flag.
The commit removes the per‑CPU dying list used by conntrack, moves entries needing event redelivery to a per‑net dying list, and adjusts the IPS_CONFIRMED handling to avoid double unlinking.
The patch edits a comment in the ab8500 fuel‑gauge driver, removing a duplicated word ‘is is’ so the comment reads correctly.
The commit adds functionality to the DesignWare I2C driver to retrieve I2C timing parameters from firmware, mirroring an existing PCI driver helper.
Adds the X86_FEATURE_XENPV flag to disabled-features.h, causing this CPU feature to be turned off on Xen PV guests.
Reverts a previous return‑thunk modification and adds a CPU feature flag X86_FEATURE_RETHUNK to disable the change on affected processors.
Adds the AVDD and MICVDD power supply entries to the rt5682s device‑tree binding documentation, reflecting supplies already used in a board DTS.
The patch removes redundant resetting of MBA control arrays in set_mba_sc(), adds mbps_val[] reset to reset_all_ctrls(), and eliminates unnecessary architecture‑specific code.
The patch renames the vkms_composer struct to vkms_frame_info for clarity and also corrects an iosys_map_is_null check in compose_plane.
The patch changes framebuffer console (fbcon) sysfs attribute show functions to use sysfs_emit instead of snprintf/scnprintf/sprintf, aligning with the recommended API for sysfs output.

The patch removes code in the USB gadget core that assigns udc->dev.driver, ensuring the driver pointer stays NULL, which eliminates a race that caused a use‑after‑free in dev_uevent as reported by syzbot.
Adds a missing iounmap() in zorro7xx_remove_one() to release a resource allocated by ioremap() during probe, fixing a leak.

The patch renames the driver callback function set_fmt_new back to the standard set_fmt name for the jz4740-i2s ASoC driver, reflecting that the core audio subsystem now uses the new direct clock specification.
The patch reorders logic in the r8188eu driver’s OnDisassoc handler, extracting the non‑access‑point case from a large conditional block so it is processed first, simplifying the function’s flow.

Moves async flip capability validation earlier in the i915 atomic check, introduces intel_async_flip_check_uapi() and adds basic checks (CRTC active, modeset flag, plane enabled) to ensure async flips are only requested when supported.
The patch removes kernel-doc annotations from static functions in the drm/edid subsystem, considering them excessive, while keeping the explanatory text as ordinary comments.

Updates the spear-keyboard input driver to use DEFINE_SIMPLE_DEV_PM_OPS() with pm_sleep_ptr() instead of the deprecated SIMPLE_DEV_PM_OPS(), removing __maybe_unused attributes and suppressing compiler warnings while keeping the same power‑management behavior.

The patch modifies the RDMA core to compute the UDP source port using the GRH flow label, falling back to the local or remote QP numbers when the flow label is absent, and sets this port in the packet.
Adds support for the on‑board RT711 SDCA audio codec on Intel Meteor Lake (MTL) reference platform, integrating it into the ASoC Intel SOF SDW driver.

The patch changes intel_gt_mcr_wait_for_reg_fw() to acquire and release uncore->lock internally, fixing a missing lock acquisition that caused race conditions and lockdep assertions, and avoids holding the lock during long waits.
The patch adds a new ACPI identifier for a newer AMD PMC controller variant to the kernel's supported ID list, allowing the driver to recognize and initialize that hardware.
The patch modifies the r8188eu driver to replace its own get_da call with the generic ieee80211_get_DA function from ieee80211.h, updating the source accordingly.
Adds a new device tree compatible string for the Elan eth3915n touchscreen controller, indicating it is compatible with the ekth3500 driver.
The commit updates the sfc driver to replace scnprintf calls in sysfs show() functions with sysfs_emit(), aligning with sysfs coding guidelines.
Adds support for Intel LBR format V7 on Goldmont+ and Tremont CPUs, introduces shared capability flags in struct x86_pmu and an init routine to set them, simplifying LBR capability detection.
The patch consolidates the LED handling structures in the r8188eu driver by merging struct LED_871x into struct led_priv, moving all LED_871x fields into led_priv, simplifying the LED layer.
The commit adjusts the NFP driver to avoid reading a 32‑bit capability word from a non‑qword‑aligned address, preventing exceptions on certain architectures.

Adds a consistency check in nf_tables: when a set specifies field_count, the NFT_SET_CONCAT flag must be set; otherwise returns EINVAL. Also rejects NFT_SET_CONCAT without field_count. Implements validation logic in the netfilter code.
Creates the Linux 6.2-rc1 release, updating version identifiers and tagging the source tree for the first release candidate.
Reverts the restrictive APIC‑write check added earlier, allowing non‑ICR MSR writes required for x2AVIC, thereby fixing the regression introduced by commit 5413bcba7ed5.

The patch corrects the TLV length check in tipc_nl_compat_name_table_dump_header by casting the size expression to int, handling cases where TLV_GET_DATA_LEN() returns a negative value and eliminating the KMSAN uninitialized‑value bug reported by syzbot.
Adds a compatible string for the Altera SoCFPGA Stratix‑10 Development Kit in the arm64 device‑tree, enabling the kernel to recognize this board.
Adds missing HDMI power supply properties (avdd-0v9-supply, avdd-1v8-supply) to the rk3399-roc-pc device‑tree node, eliminating a kernel warning and aligning the naming with the hardware schematic.
Renames the Kconfig symbol for the IIO test format suite to CONFIG_IIO_TEST_FORMAT_KUNIT_TEST, aligning with KUnit’s required CONFIG_<name>_KUNIT_TEST pattern.

The commit updates the KVM arm64 selftest to disable single‑step debugging using the proper KVM_GUESTDBG_ENABLE flag instead of the unrelated SINGLE_STEP_DISABLE enum, which coincidentally has the same value. No runtime behavior changes.
Updates the Qualcomm GSBI device‑tree binding files to the new DT schema format, replacing the previous binding representation.

The patch splits sd_read_protection() into two functions, postpones integrity probing to the end of SCSI device discovery, and removes a redundant revalidate call that previously queried the same parameters twice, also simplifying some log output.
Adds pinctrl entries for SSI1 and sound_dai nodes to the RZ/G2UL SMARC EVK device tree, activating audio hardware support on that board.

The commit removes the driver‑enforced edge‑rising interrupt trigger for ath10k_snoc, allowing the interrupt type to be taken from the device tree, fixing binding failures on Qualcomm WCN3990 hardware.

Reverts the change that added an erroneous __user qualifier to the buffer argument of proc_dointvec_minmax_sysadmin() after moving the function to printk/sysctl, restoring correct type and silencing sparse warnings.

The patch adds a GPIO interrupt handler and implements four irq_chip helper functions (irq_set_type, irq_mask, irq_unmask, irq_ack) for the Microchip pci1xxxx driver, enabling configuration, masking, unmasking and acknowledgment of GPIO IRQs.
Deletes the unused 'work' member from struct mlx5e_async_ctx in the mlx5e driver, eliminating dead code.
Fixes rxrpc congestion management by resetting the congestion window after idle periods and preserving ssthresh, eliminating the deadlock caused when a saved cwnd of zero prevented any transmission.
The patch moves root helper functions that were mistakenly placed in accessors.h back into ctree.h, aligning them with btrfs_root definitions and simplifying header synchronization with btrfs-progs.
The commit adds support for the SMUIO hardware block introduced in AMDGPU version 13.0.9, implementing a software function to handle this block during driver discovery.
The patch raises the maximum DRAM bandwidth percentage for AMD DCN315 display hardware to 60%, fixing DML validation failures when multiple HDR displays are connected.
The patch updates the mpt3sas SCSI driver to perform its 4 GB boundary check using the pool's DMA address instead of the virtual address, correcting the check logic.
Adds a GPIO property to the wcd938x ASoC device-tree binding, allowing the codec to select between CTIA and OMTP headset wiring via a configurable GPIO.

The patch fixes a use‑after‑free bug in the mlx5e driver by freeing VLAN resources with mlx5e_fs_vlan_free(fs) before the main fs structure is kvfreed, preventing dangling pointer accesses during initialization.

The patch restores proper peer deletion for QCA6390/WCN6855 when a station disconnects, fixing a use‑after‑free caused by earlier code that skipped the peer delete command. It adjusts the WMI command handling so the peer is freed and its pointer cleared.
Deletes the unused function rxrpc_get_reply_time() from the RxRPC code because the system now uses call issue time instead of reply time.
The commit updates the maintainer's e‑mail address in the dt‑bindings repository, preferring the Bootlin address over the previous one.

The patch updates the musb mpfs driver probe function so that error‑handling branches return proper negative errno codes instead of zero, correcting the previous behavior where failures were reported as success.

The driver previously registered netdev_notifiers during each device probe, causing duplicate registrations when multiple ADIN1110/2111 devices are present. The patch moves the registration to the module initialization function so all instances share a single notifier registration, eliminating warnings and probe failures.
The patch replaces JFS's ->writepage implementation with the generic ->migrate_folio helper and deletes the now‑unused ->writepage code, improving write‑back efficiency.

Adds support for a new queue allocation command in iwlwifi, updating the driver API to use a station mask and revised flags, and implements required queue removal before station removal as firmware no longer handles it.
Adds a helper function virt_get_pte_hva() to the KVM aarch64 self‑test suite, translating a guest virtual address to the host virtual address of its page‑table entry for use by future tests.
Removes obsolete perfbuf API functions from libbpf and tidies the associated option structures, simplifying the library's interface.

Adds a device‑specific quirk for the Fiero SC‑01 USB audio interface when running firmware version 1.0.0, reusing the workaround already present for firmware 1.1.0, enabling correct handling of hard‑coded sample rates.
The patch changes io_uring_enter to stop running pending task work at entry, deferring it until after submissions, which enables better batching and avoids unnecessary work.
Updates OMAP3 device tree to group CM_ICLKEN_WKUP clocks using the TI clksel binding and adds clock-output-names, eliminating dtc warnings about unique unit addresses and non‑standard node names.
Corrects a spelling typo in a comment within the OCFS2 filesystem code; no functional changes are introduced.
The patch modifies try_to_free_swap to accept a folio instead of a page, removing extra compound_head calls and reducing kernel text size by roughly 74 bytes.
Changes cfg80211_auth_request.key_idx from unsigned to signed to allow -1 sentinel values and silence static‑analysis warnings; no functional behavior change.
Adds a reset argument to the mtk_wed_tx_ring_setup function, preparing the driver to support Wireless Ethernet Dispatcher reset operations.
Adds admin‑only capability checks to NVMe management ioctl commands (reset, rescan, etc.), matching the existing restriction on passthrough commands.
The patch updates the AMD KFD driver so that when CRIU restores a checkpoint, each recreated queue is given the same sdma id it had during the dump, preserving the original identifier.
The patch edits the r8188eu staging driver, deleting the HW_VAR_AC_PARAM_VI usage in SetHwReg8188EU() and replacing it with a direct rtw_write32() call, simplifying the register‑setting code.
Replaces snprintf calls in drivers/bus/mhi/host/init.c with sysfs_emit/sysfs_emit_at to satisfy a Coccinelle warning about preferred sysfs output functions.

Updates the OMAP3 device tree to group CONTROL_DEVCONF0 clocks using the TI clksel binding and adds clock-output-names, removing unique_unit_address and node_name_chars_strict warnings with W=1/2 make flags.
Adds a pinctrl/GPIO driver for Intel Meteor Lake, implementing support for the next‑generation GPIO hardware while reusing the existing Intel core pinctrl infrastructure.
The commit extracts the QCS404 remote processor Peripheral Authentication Service device‑tree bindings into a dedicated file, reducing complexity and easing maintenance of the dt‑bindings tree.
Adds the bi-tcxo clock name to the Qualcomm SDM845 camera clock controller device-tree binding, updating the schema so the driver can recognize this clock.
The commit changes the dsa_switch struct field num_ports from size_t (8 bytes) to unsigned int (4 bytes) to eliminate unnecessary padding and shrink the overall struct size.
Removes unnecessary chip type comment lines from the ftdi_sio USB serial driver, cleaning up the source without altering any functionality.
The patch updates rxe_av.c in the RDMA/rxe driver, replacing all uses of the generic pr_* logging macros with the driver‑specific rxe_dbg_* macros, aligning debug output with the rxe subsystem.

The patch modifies the amdgpu driver to stop using the amdgpu_ras_need_send_ras_feature helper and directly checks the GFX RAS block, ensuring the RAS enable_feature command is sent only for the graphics IP block.
The commit edits the MAINTAINERS file to delete Jukka Rissanen's entry as the 6lowpan maintainer because he no longer works on it.
Initializes the previously uninitialized variable ‘next’ in find_first_clear_extent_bit of Btrfs, removing a compile‑time error that appeared when syncing extent-io-tree.c into btrfs-progs.

Adds fields and logic to the i915 buddy allocator to record total visible memory and per‑resource used visible memory, updates debug output and accounts for reserved memory, enabling future allocation and eviction decisions.
Adds a common mechanism for CXL.mem endpoint drivers to enumerate ancestor CXL switch ports, validate CXL.mem links, and manage race conditions via parent port locks and placeholder references.
The patch deletes the unused function fscrypt_set_test_dummy_encryption() after all callers have been switched to newer APIs, cleaning up dead code in the fscrypt subsystem.

The commit updates the hisi_acc VFIO driver to use new device lifecycle helper functions, moves migration‑specific initialization from the probe routine to a dedicated init callback, and deletes the now‑unused vfio_pci_core_{un}init_device() helpers.
The commit moves the decision about bio cloning into submit_stripe_bio, removing the now‑redundant orig_bio and clone parameters because they can be derived from existing structures.

The patch modifies the Renesas r8a77470 pinctrl driver to replace full reserved register field descriptions with compact shorthands (negative width) and merges adjacent reserved fields, reducing kernel size.
Reorders the if/else chain that selects frequency tables based on GRAPHICS_VER, handling newer versions first to improve readability and future extensibility.
Updates the copy of struct vmcb_control_area in KVM nSVM self‑tests to match the kernel's latest definition, allowing the tests to cover newly introduced VMCB features.

The patch removes the buddy prefetch step from free_pcppages_bulk() in the page allocator. It argues that prefetching under the zone lock adds unnecessary work and offers little benefit, so the code is simplified and the prefetch logic is deleted.
Adds a PowerPC perf self‑test that enables branch stack and verifies it does not crash on any platform, exercising the earlier crash‑fix code path.
Updates ftpm_mod_init in the TPM FTPM TEE driver to check driver_register()'s return value and unregister ftpm_tee_plat_driver when registration fails, ensuring correct cleanup.
The commit updates the max310x serial driver to populate the rs485_supported field, documenting which serial_rs485 capabilities the hardware provides.
Reorganizes the HOP helper functions in the Habana Labs MMU V1 driver to use newly defined shift/mask arrays, simplifying the implementation and improving code clarity.
The patch changes the log level for failures of devm_thermal_of_zone_register() from error to debug, because -ENODEV is expected when a thermal zone is absent, reducing unnecessary error messages.
The patch changes the USB control‑message timeout used when reading the EDID in the udl DRM driver to the standard USB timeout constant (5 seconds), aligning it with other drivers.

The patch modifies the amdgpu driver to stop programming gfxhub_v3_0_3 system aperture registers for SR‑IOV virtual functions, because those registers are no longer in the RLCG access range and must be set by the host.
The patch deletes the vgpu->released flag and its associated sanity‑check code in the i915 GVT driver because VFIO core now handles the vGPU lifecycle, making the flag redundant.
The commit deletes the arch_has_empty_bitmaps field from the x86 resctrl code because min_cbm_bits already provides sufficient validation for zero capacity bit masks.
Adds a helper function for RAS poison‑mode queries and renames it, avoiding unnecessary queries on SR‑IOV guests and simplifying the driver code.
Changes ata_port::fastdrain_cnt from unsigned long to unsigned int because it is only ever assigned 32‑bit values, reducing size without altering behavior.
Updates the filesystem helper is_partially_uptodate to take a folio argument, matching the per‑folio uptodate flag and clarifying that it returns a boolean and uses byte counts.
The commit reorders the entries of CONFIG_SURFACE_PLATFORMS in RISC-V defconfig files to match the ordering produced by savedefconfig, without altering any functional behavior.
The patch corrects the selection of the microengine (ME) used in the map_queue packet for GFX11 AMDGPU, ensuring the appropriate ME for graphics, compute, or scheduling is chosen.

The patch modifies the tracing subsystem so that traceon/traceoff triggers, when attached to an event, affect only the specific tracing instance rather than the global tracing state, correcting confusing behavior for users.
The patch adds a helper function mcp251xfd_is_fd_mode() to test whether the MCP251xfd CAN controller operates in CAN-FD mode and replaces existing inline checks with calls to this function.

The patch cleans up the BPF self‑test code by eliminating the previously required mount and unmount of /sys and /sys/fs/bpf in the open_netns and close_netns helpers, as earlier patches made those mounts unnecessary.

The patch updates the ssd130x DRM driver to obtain the plane state via drm_atomic_get_new_plane_state() instead of directly accessing the plane's .state field, aligning with the atomic API. No functional behavior is changed.
Converts the existing boolean sysregs_loaded_on_cpu in the KVM arm64 vcpu structure into a dedicated state flag, reflecting that it is a host‑only concern about register residency in VHE mode.
Adds a forward declaration of struct folio in cacheflush.h so that the header can be included without compilation warnings about an unknown type.
The patch modifies the mt76 mt7921 driver to stop discarding received frames that use VHT MCS indices 10‑11, which the hardware can handle, thereby allowing those frames to be processed.
Adds a device‑tree binding and clk-phase-sd-hs property to the SDMMC node on SocFPGA, allowing the driver to adjust the CIU clock phase via the system manager.
Adds a free() call for the parsed command‑line arguments structure in rtla/osnoise, releasing the allocated memory before the tool exits.

Updates AMD DRM driver to handle SubVP Dynamic Refresh Rate cases: avoids locking during VSYNC flips, programs DRR triggers via firmware for DCN32/321, and adds a command bit to mark SubVP pipe as DRR.

The patch renames the reference‑counting helpers in the rxe RDMA driver: rxe_add_ref() becomes rxe_get() and rxe_drop_ref() becomes rxe_put(), improving naming consistency and readability without altering functionality.
Adds a missing swap_free() call in try_to_unmap() when arch_unmap_one() fails, undoing a prior swap_duplicate() to correctly release the swap cache entry and prevent corruption or leak.
Adds a cs_dsp library that bridges the cs35l41 DSP with HDA drivers, exposing DSP controls as ALSA controls, and corrects the CONFIG_SND_HDA_CS_DSP_CONTROLS Kconfig dependency.
The commit updates the kernel version identifier to 5.19-rc6, marking a release candidate tag.
The patch updates KVM x86 MMU iterator logic to automatically refresh iter->old_spte after a failed cmpxchg, removing manual re‑reads and consolidating duplicated code.
Adds driver support for retrieving I2C bus clock frequency via standard clock bindings (clk_rate or clock property), falling back to legacy clk_rate if needed.
Adds a printk that logs the gap hole end size on x86 UV platforms, exposing the number of physical address bits used. Improves visibility of platform memory layout during boot.
Initializes the vqs_list_lock in vdev_info_init() so virtio_test no longer hangs in __vring_new_virtqueue(), fixing a runtime failure.

Implements a new hot‑page selection algorithm for NUMA‑balancing memory tiering using hint‑page‑fault latency, reuses struct page bits, adds a debugfs threshold interface, and includes a small fix for disabling tiering.
Adds a Chinese translation of the devicetree changesets documentation (changesets.rst) under docs/zh_CN, updating the documentation tree without modifying any kernel code.
Fixes size mismatch in LSE atomic macro casts on arm64, replacing unsigned long* cast with correctly sized type to silence -Warray-bounds warnings without altering generated code.

The commit relocates the extract‑cert script from scripts/ to the certs/ directory and adjusts the build system so the script is compiled only when needed, reflecting a reorganization of build assets.
Allows MTU changes while the network interface is up by releasing and reopening the stmmac driver and invoking set_filter, removing the EBUSY error that previously required the interface to be down.

The patch moves the KVM x86 PMU operations structure (.pmu_ops) into the init‑only ops table (kvm_x86_init_ops) and marks it __initdata, reducing runtime memory usage and ensuring the ops cannot be altered after initialization.
Removes the stale MAINTAINERS entry for max77693.txt after the DT binding was migrated to a YAML file, fixing the maintainer metadata.
The patch updates the Qualcomm SM8350 pinctrl device‑tree binding to stop requiring a 'function' property for pins that are not GPIOs, such as SD‑card pins.
Adds a BPF self‑test that reproduces a decl_tag issue in func_proto return types, expecting a WARN_ON_ONCE in btf_type_id_size.
The patch modifies the RTC self‑test suite to detect if a real‑time clock device is absent and, in that case, skip the test instead of marking it as failed.

The patch updates fbtft_init_display() to correctly print the init sequence values, which are signed 16‑bit, by replacing the existing print code with a call to fbtft_par_dbg_hex(), ensuring proper debug output.

The commit addresses a race condition in the Hyper-V network driver (hv_netvsc) where a virtual function (VF) registration can occur before the host sends the VF association message during VM boot, causing the VF path to break. It adds a guard to delay registration until the bind message arrives.
The patch adds a reference to the mm struct when a range is queued in the SVM deferred list and releases it after processing, preventing use‑after‑free and mm_count leaks in the AMDGPU driver.

Adds optional prepare_streaming and unprepare_streaming operations to the videobuf2 queue API so drivers can claim and release streaming resources when VIDIOC_STREAMON/OFF is invoked, enabling earlier resource management.

The patch modifies the qla2xxx driver to tear down an existing firmware session before a relogin when the authentication application starts, preventing repeated login attempts caused by mismatched WWPN sizes.
The patch adds a reference‑count hold on the rawmidi output buffer during snd_rawmidi_drain_output() and makes the close path check that count, preventing buffer resize while draining.

The patch moves several exported extent_io_tree helper functions from the Btrfs core file to extent-io-tree.c, consolidating helpers that don’t rely on tree_search() and shrinking the core source file.
Introduces a new internal helper __vcpu_run() in KVM self‑tests to wrap the KVM_RUN ioctl, letting tests avoid writing their own ioctl call and assert handling.
The patch adds mt7915_set_radar_background and related MCU commands to configure a dedicated DFS receive chain, enabling zero‑wait DFS (CAC) detection on the rdd2 hardware path.
Adds a device‑tree entry for RK3399 VOPs defining the gamma LUT memory region at base+0x2000, enabling kernel support for gamma control on this SoC.

The patch disables the KVM_HC_CLOCK_PAIRING hypercall when a vCPU has tsc_always_catchup set, because the hypercall’s retry loop would otherwise never exit, causing an infinite loop. It also adjusts warning handling and changes the return code to KVM_EFAULT.
Adds a missing @server parameter description to the kernel-doc comment of smb311_update_preauth_hash, removing a warning generated by scripts/kernel-doc.
The patch updates the Qualcomm ARM dt-bindings header to include new SoC identifiers for the QDU1000 and QRU1000 platforms and their variants, enabling device tree files to reference these IDs.

The patch corrects the error‑handling logic in the ipaq‑micro MFD driver: platform_get_irq() returns a negative error code, but the code previously tested the IRQ pointer for NULL. The change replaces the null check with a check for a value < 0.
Updates rcutorture to create and bind a kernel thread on a specific CPU using kthread_run_on_cpu, replacing kthread_create_on_node, kthread_bind, and wake_up_process, thus simplifying the code.

The patch restructures the lpfc driver SLI handling, moving all RSCN/SCR/RDF/EDC/FARPR code to use the SLI‑4 generic get/set API and separates SLI‑3 and SLI‑4 specific sections, eliminating indirect structure accesses.

The commit moves panel‑specific VBT parsing to the output probing stage, splits the VBT data into per‑panel and global parts, stores panel data in connector->panel.vbt, and drops a micro‑optimisation check.

The patch removes an unnecessary assignment to the variable 'bytes' in sound/pci/echoaudio/midi.c, which was overwritten later and never read, eliminating a dead store warning from clang static analysis.
The commit adds a platform‑specific data structure for Intel's Agilex SoC to the DWC2 USB driver, indicating that the DWC2 IP on this platform cannot use clock‑gating.

The patch deletes the _bh annotation from all spinlocks in the rxrpc subsystem because RCU callbacks no longer acquire spinlocks and packet processing now runs in a regular I/O thread rather than soft‑irq context.
Updates the TI DAC5571 IIO driver to use i2c's .probe_new() callback, which lacks the i2c_device_id argument, and adds explicit code to obtain the device ID inside the probe.
The commit removes dead code, conditionals and unused options from the Qualcomm QMP UFS PHY driver, simplifying the driver implementation.
Adds a write to the GCC_SDCC_BCR register in the sdhci‑msm driver init, resetting the SDHC controller and clearing prior power‑control state to prevent timeout failures during reset.
The patch updates the RISC‑V Canaan (k210) device‑tree, splitting a combined timer node into two separate nodes with correct interrupt spec lengths, eliminating dtbs_check schema warnings.
Adds a new compatible string for the Qualcomm CCI found in MSM8974 SoC, enabling device tree descriptions for hardware with two I2C masters.

Loads the actual number of virtual address bits (vabits_actual) during the CPU resume path on arm64, correcting a mismatch introduced by a prior change to __cpu_setup(), fixing boot failures on 52-bit configurations such as Juno.
Adds proper error handling in ssi_init() for the OMAP SSI core driver: checks platform_driver_register() return value and unregisters ssi_pdriver on failure to avoid leaked registration.
Adjusts bio_copy_data_iter to honor destination bvec offsets, fixing incorrect data copying in bcache scenarios where bios have non‑zero offsets.
The patch adds a reset‑GPIO option to the onboard USB hub driver, changing the reset handling to release the line after power‑up and assert it again before power‑down.
The commit adjusts the driver’s include list: it removes unused of_irq.h and of_platform.h headers and adds the missing mod_devicetable.h, ensuring correct compilation and header usage.
The patch changes a left‑shift of a signed 32‑bit integer by 31 bits to use an unsigned type, eliminating undefined behavior flagged by UBSAN in __mdiobus_register.
Adds const qualifiers to struct detailed_timing pointers used in DRM EDID parsing callbacks, enhancing const‑correctness of the code.

The patch updates the xHCI driver to stop enabling U1 and U2 link‑power‑management states for USB 3 devices behind tier‑2 or deeper hubs when Intel’s tier policy disallows LPM, moving the policy check earlier to avoid extra MEL commands.
The patch deletes a redundant return variable in the r8188eu driver’s rtw_wx_get_essid function, which was always initialized to 0 and never overwritten, simplifying the code.
Adds a check to skip starting the ext4lazyinit thread when an ext4 filesystem is mounted read‑only, since block allocation and bitmap prefetching are unnecessary.
The commit updates the device‑tree for STM32 ARM SoCs, renaming pinctrl nodes to the standard 'pinctrl' name to silence warnings introduced by the new pinctrl.yaml binding.
Removes Naveen Krishna Chatradhi from the dt-bindings/hwmon/ntc-thermistor maintainers list because the email address bounces.
The commit updates the kernel-doc script to replace its custom usage/error handling with Pod::Usage, so documentation printing is handled via the standard Perl module.
Adds ability for the TPS68470 clock driver to accept multiple platform data consumers, enabling several sensors to acquire the same clock on x86 platforms.
Introduces the can327 driver, a CAN line‑discipline that repurposes ELM327 OBD‑II adapters as inexpensive CAN interfaces, and adds accompanying documentation and minor style tweaks.
The patch adjusts the spacing in the heading row of the ext4 blockmap documentation table to align cells, eliminating a Sphinx "Malformed table" warning that prevented the table from loading.

Updates the thermal mmio driver to use the new Open Firmware (OF) API, converting its callbacks to the generic thermal_zone_device_ops format and registering the zone via the new API, simplifying initialization.
Updates Mediatek DDP component enum to add indexed DITHER0 and modifies MT8365 mutex module arrays to use the new enum, ensuring internal consistency; no functional behavior changes.
The patch modifies blk-crypto to pass the gendisk structure to the sysfs register/unregister helpers, preparing the block layer for upcoming sysfs handling changes.

The patch removes the css_set_lock spinlock around kernfs_walk_and_get (which may sleep) and adds a special helper for the default cgroup hierarchy, ensuring the root cgroup is safely referenced without being freed.
Re-enables the internal pull‑down for the eMMC PHY strobe line in the Nanopi4 device tree to fix I/O errors in HS400 mode.
Adds support for DSD audio bit formats (DSD_U8, DSD_U16_LE, DSD_U32_LE) to the Freescale SAI driver in the ASoC subsystem, extending the driver to handle these new formats.
Adds missing cleanup in the probe and resource‑setup error paths of the sun8i_a83t MIPI CSI‑2 driver, releasing allocated resources like the remove function to avoid leaks on failure.
The patch adds a unique prefix to the macros in the gpio-f7188x driver to keep the GPIO macro namespace clean, without changing any functional behavior.

The patch makes reads from /dev/urandom attempt a best‑effort entropy generation; if successful the RNG is marked initialized, otherwise behavior is unchanged. It replaces a previously reverted required‑try approach.
The commit reorders RTC CMOS driver initialization so that the ACPI fixed event handler is registered only after the driver data structure is set up, preventing a NULL‑pointer dereference on boot.
The commit corrects a typo in the IOAT DMA engine module description, changing "idel" to "idle". It only modifies the module description text without altering code behavior.
Updates numerous comments in mm/vmscan and related shmem code, replacing incorrect 'pages' terminology with 'folios' after the folio conversion.
Updates the AD5380 DAC IIO driver to use the i2c .probe_new() callback, adding code to retrieve the i2c_device_id manually because .probe_new() lacks that argument.

The patch renames the function iscsi_conn_queue_work() to iscsi_conn_queue_xmit() throughout the iSCSI driver, updating all call sites to match the new name, reflecting that the function only queues transmit operations.

The patch modifies __io_account_mem in the io_uring subsystem to use atomic_long_try_cmpxchg instead of atomic_long_cmpxchg, removing an unnecessary comparison and simplifying the code while preserving existing behavior.

The patch removes now‑redundant validation checks in the IOMMU driver’s release_device path, because release_device is invoked via per‑device operations only after successful probe. It also stops freeing fwspec structures that the core now handles, simplifying the code.
The commit corrects a misspelled word 'postion' to 'position' in the IB/qib driver source, likely in comments or strings, without altering functionality.
Adds the #reset-cells property with value 1 to the Mediatek MT8192/MT8195 device-tree binding, referencing the infra_ao reset defined in the sys-clock bindings.
The commit adds handling for PCI device ID 0x3b57 (Intel 5 Series/3400) in the ALSA HDA driver, using the same capabilities as 0x3b56, thereby enabling HDMI/DP audio via i915.

The patch updates the clocksource-switch self‑test to correctly propagate child process errors. It replaces a direct return of system()'s waitpid‑style value with proper macro handling (e.g., WIFEXITED/WEXITSTATUS) so that failures are not masked by exit()'s implicit zero.
Adds support for configuring the driver’s tx_push feature via ethtool’s ring‑parameter get/set (‑G/‑g) by extending the ringparam API and related data structures.
Removes an unnecessary 'return;' statement from a void function in the ALSA HDA VIA driver, cleaning up the code without altering functionality.

The patch modifies kernel configuration to allow rcuscale to be built without automatically enabling RCU Tasks on PREEMPT_NONE kernels, removing an unnecessary dependency and reducing kernel size and tracing complexity.

Adds checks for rxe_get() return in RDMA/rxe tasklets (completer, responder, requester) to detect failure when the qp's reference count has dropped to zero, preparing for a later change that will drop the ref before flushing tasklets.
Adds proper teardown of tagger-owned storage in DSA switch drivers, ensuring the storage allocated during tag protocol setup is freed on driver unbind, preventing leaks and use‑after‑free.

The patch adds support in the io_uring subsystem to store two 64‑bit return values for 32‑bit completion queue entries (CQE32). It reuses the existing hash‑list node as a container for this extra data, enabling the kernel to pass back the values.
The patch modifies the BPF XDP redirect self‑test to create a temporary network namespace instead of using a fixed name, avoiding conflicts when the namespace already exists.
The patch updates the ASoC qdsp6 audioreach driver to calculate the module_list size inside the modules loop, removing a separate size‑calculation step.

Prevents existing DSA master network devices from being attached as upper interfaces of other devices, except for tag‑none switches, to allow LAG interfaces of DSA masters to be masters themselves while disallowing later addition of new upper ports.
Adds qca8k_bulk_read/write helpers that use the management Ethernet path for bulk packet I/O and updates the FDB code to use them, also shrinking the FDB register count from 4 to 3.

Adds logic to the mlx5 driver to query and probe active Subfunction (SF) devices during driver probe, ensuring SFs are recreated after the parent driver is unloaded/reloaded when SFs and port representors are on different functions.

The commit replaces separate dma_set_mask and dma_set_coherent_mask calls with a single dma_set_mask_and_coherent call in the qed driver, removes dead code, and folds a helper into its caller, simplifying the code.
The commit adds a kernel configuration option to allow building the AMD RPL Platform ACP audio drivers, making them selectable in the build system.
The commit replaces the existing arm64 strcmp implementation with the latest version from ARM Optimized Routines, adding support for Memory Tagging Extension (MTE) while handling licensing.

The commit modifies the lpfc driver to obtain VMID registration information from the fabric's FLOGI_ACC service parameters instead of static module parameters, ensuring the driver adapts to different switch implementations.
Adds a RAS poison creation handler to the amdgpu driver and separates the UMC handler, preparing for future poison consumption handling.
Updates the maintainer field in dt-bindings/clock/rockchip,rk3399-cru.yaml, replacing an outdated author with the current Rockchip clock maintainer as requested.

The patch stops ext4 from calling inode_inc_iversion() on EA inodes (marked with EXT4_EA_INODE_FL) because those inodes reuse i_version for part of their reference count, fixing a failure observed in xfstest ext4/026.
The commit updates the default PSCI version reported to KVM guests on arm64 from the previous version to 1.1, so that PSCI_VERSION returns the newer number.
Replaces strlcpy calls with strscpy in the misc subsystem where the return value was unused, using a coccinelle script to follow kernel coding guidance.
Updates Qualcomm MSM8960 pin controller device tree bindings to the new DT schema format, standardising subnode naming with other Qualcomm schemas.
The patch adds code to free the mount options structure when ntfs_fill_super() fails, eliminating a memory leak reported by syzbot.
The patch removes a redundant call that sent the EnableGfxImu message twice in the AMDGPU power‑management code, ensuring the message is only issued once during set_gfx_power_up_by_imu.
Implements a macro in mm/damon/modules-common to generate identical module parameters for DAMON_RECLAIM and DAMON_LRU_SORT, reducing code duplication and enabling reuse.

The patch modifies the CC_HAS_ASM_GOTO_TIED_OUTPUT test in init/Kconfig, removing a newline that caused spurious syntax errors when /bin/sh is dash, so the test correctly evaluates the compiler feature.
The patch deletes the mt8195-specific MOD0 and SOF0 definitions and makes the driver reuse the existing mt8183 definitions, simplifying the Mediatek mutex code.
Adds a hard limit of 256 retries for Ceph MDS requests to avoid overflow of the 8‑bit retry counter, preventing incorrect retry sequences.
Renames io_uring request handler functions so preparation handlers end with _prep and issue handlers use the base name, making naming consistent across the subsystem.
The patch adds a guard in ocfs2_dlm_shutdown() to skip freeing a DLM resource when it was never initialized, preventing a kernel crash that occurs after a mount failure in local mode.
Moves the calcs directory containing FPU code into the DML directory to follow project layout guidelines and fixes compile issues when DCN is disabled, without changing functionality.
Adjusts NTFS3's attr_punch_hole handling to correctly process very fragmented attributes, fixing a failure that occurred in such cases.

The patch modifies Btrfs's resolve_indirect_refs() to call free_leaf_list() instead of ulist_free() on error paths, ensuring inode lists attached via the ulist node's aux field are freed and eliminating a memory leak.
The patch edits spte.h in the KVM x86 MMU code to delete a duplicated phrase "be split" in a comment or string, correcting it to a single occurrence.
The patch introduces a new helper function create_pidcomm in the perf timechart subsystem, extracting duplicated code that allocates and initializes per-pid communication structures.
The patch fixes a rare bug in the rxe RDMA driver where the memory region (mr) value was not correctly computed in read_reply(), causing the rping benchmark to fail on long runs.

The commit adjusts the bq25890 power driver to use regulator_init_data only for the VBUS regulator, removing it from the VSYS regulator configuration. This prevents duplicate consumer supply registration that caused probe failures, fixing the driver initialization.
Fixes migrate_pages() handling of THP/hugetlbfs migration failures returning -ENOSYS by moving failed THP pages to the correct list and aligning error handling between THP and hugetlbfs.
Adds acquisition of RPM runtime‑pm wakelock around the PXP unbind path in the i915 driver to stop warnings about hardware access without the wakelock, similar to a prior suspend fix.
The patch updates the PSP_BL_CMD enumeration in the amdgpu driver to match the definitions used by the trusted OS, fixing a mismatch between driver and firmware interfaces.

The patch changes the bonding driver to use __struct_group() when copying IP/IPv6 addresses into flow_key, eliminating compiler warnings about possible over‑read and correcting the copy to only reference the source address fields.

Adds a transmit_in_progress_aborted flag and abort logic to the CEC driver so that when a pending transmit is canceled, the driver marks it aborted and avoids retry, preventing hardware buffer overwrite and garbled bus data.
The commit updates the MAINTAINERS file to replace Al Cooper with the author as the internal and upstream maintainer for the Broadcom USB driver.
The commit extracts timeout opcode definitions and their handling code from the main io_uring implementation into a dedicated source file, improving modularity and readability.
The patch renames struct udl_drm_connector to udl_connector in the UDL DRM driver and adds a macro for upcasting from drm_connector, with no functional changes.
Removes the unused __arch_set_user_pkey_access() declaration from the x86/pkeys code, cleaning up dead code that is neither used nor defined.
Removes the reg_from_user() and reg_to_user() helper functions in KVM arm64 and replaces their usage with standard get_user()/put_user(), simplifying the code.
Updates the net DSA documentation by correcting typographical, grammar, and punctuation errors.
The commit updates Documentation/process/changes.rst, replacing a hard‑coded kernel version (e.g., 4.x) with the placeholder 'latest' to keep the document current for future releases.
The patch modifies the rockchip-inno-usb2 PHY driver IRQ handler to stop acquiring a mutex when clearing the bvalid interrupt, because the clear operation is atomic and the lock is unnecessary.
Aligns tcp_bpf_recvmsg_parser error handling with TCP stack, ensuring correct error codes are returned to applications using sockmap.
Adds missing ida_simple_remove() in the probe error path and replaces deprecated ida_simple_get()/remove() with ida_alloc()/ida_free() to correctly balance IDA allocation.

The commit reverts a previous modification that filled the DCN315 clock table using dcfclk values. The revert is needed because when dcfclk states are disabled, the table leads to a no‑read/underflow condition, so the change restores the prior behavior until a proper fix is implemented.
Adds a debugfs file amdgpu_reset_level in the amdgpu driver, allowing developers to test, debug, and optionally block specific GPU reset types, with mode2 reset disabled by default.

The commit corrects KVM's vgic handling on arm64 so that when an interrupt is mapped to a hardware interrupt, the pending state is read from the physical distributor (or the timer) instead of the virtual distributor, fixing inaccurate pending reports observed after acknowledging the timer interrupt.

The patch updates the i915 driver’s watermark code to use REG_FIELD_PREP and REG_FIELD_GET macros for PLANE_WM_BLOCKS_MASK and related registers, replacing manual bitwise operations to improve consistency and avoid size mismatches.
Removes an unused forward declaration from pwm.h that was only needed before a prior commit dropped the per‑chip dbg_show callback, cleaning up the header.

The patch changes ipa_table_init_add() to accept only two flag arguments (filter and ipv6) instead of an opcode and separate hashed/non‑hashed region IDs, using ipa_table_mem() to resolve the correct memory region and dropping the assumption that a hashed entry always exists.
Extracts all devlink‑related code from dsa.c and dsa2.c into a new devlink.c and creates a dedicated devlink.h, reducing reliance on the generic dsa_priv.h and cleaning up driver source files.
The commit corrects a race in page_remove_file_rmap() that could miss updating NR_FILE_MAPPED counters for huge pages, moving the __mod_lruvec_page_state() call to ensure accurate accounting.
Adds code to io_uring poll cancellation to forward the uring locking state (issue_flags) to the cancellation callbacks, preparing them to acquire the uring lock.
The commit updates the device‑tree bindings documentation for the Mali‑Bifrost GPU on the Renesas RZ/V2L (R9A07G054) SoC by adding the appropriate compatible string entry.

Adds support for high userspace addresses in hugetlbfs by adjusting hugetlb_get_unmapped_area() to use arch_get_mmap_base/end, moving those macros to include/linux/sched/mm.h. Fixes regression where previous high‑address support for normal mmap omitted hugetlb, potentially breaking programs on ARM64 with 52‑bit VA.
Updates perf stat printing functions to accept and propagate a pointer to struct outstate, allowing shared output state across nested print calls.

The patch corrects logging in the habanalabs driver by adding required le32_to_cpu() conversions and changing the printf format to %d for values obtained via atomic_read(), ensuring correct representation of out-of-sync and packet-failure events.
Adds ACPI ID support so the Cypress CCGX Power Delivery controller on AMD ASICs can be discovered via the system I2C controller, enabling enumeration of the client.
The commit changes the aer-inject reference URL in the PCI/AER documentation to a valid repository as indicated in the how-to guide.
Extracts duplicated instruction‑patching loops in powerpc feature‑fixups into a new helper function do_patch_entry_fixups(), reducing code duplication.
The commit updates the MMP DMA engine driver to deprecate the old DT property '#dma-channels', introduces the new generic property, and retains backward compatibility for existing devices.

Migrates MediaTek clock driver code from the legacy struct clk API to the newer struct clk_hw API, updating data structures, provider calls, and helper functions using a coccinelle script and manual edits.
The patch renames the struct pcie_port to dw_pcie_rp to align with the driver’s naming convention, updating all references accordingly.
Updates the DCN315 display engine to read its clock table from DCFCLK instead of FCLK and adds validation that rejects empty PMFW tables, preventing generation of invalid DAL clock values.
The patch updates kernel-doc comments in security/lsm_audit.c to describe the missing 'ab' parameter in dump_common_audit_data, eliminating documentation warnings.
Corrects a typo in the SC8180x pinctrl wakeirq map where gpio36 and gpio37 shared the same wake IRQ number, enabling gpio37 to trigger interrupts.
Updates an outdated comment in the IPA network driver to reflect that command info entries are no longer allocated after a prior change, aligning documentation with current code behavior.
The commit updates the device tree for the sama5d27_wlsom1 board to stop enabling the unused LDO2 regulator by default, removing an always‑on setting.

The patch lowers the severity of the warning emitted for unclaimed register accesses in the i915 uncore driver from a warning to a debug message, eliminating noisy but harmless warnings introduced by a previous commit.

Reorganizes vgic attribute handling in KVM arm64 by moving early calls to vgic_{get,set}_common_attr() into the default case of a switch, consolidates pending table handling, and deduplicates vgic_v3_attr_regs_access() calls, improving code readability.
The patch changes the return handling in tve200_modeset_init() to assign a definite error code instead of an ambiguous value, eliminating a smatch static‑analysis warning.
The patch adds the PCI device identifier for Intel ADL‑S (Alder Lake‑S) to the i915 DRM driver, enabling the kernel to recognize and bind the driver to that hardware.
The patch removes the __func__ macro from dev_dbg calls in the Intel SoundWire driver, relying on dynamic debug (dyndbg) to provide module and function context when needed.
Updates the AMD GPU display driver SR watermarks for DCN3.14 using hardware‑requested tuned values, applying the new thresholds to all memory types.
Changes vfs_setxattr to take a const value pointer and removes a const‑cast hack in ovl_do_setxattr, improving const‑correctness.

The commit switches the thunderbolt driver’s KUnit test to use the new kunit_test_suite() macro, which no longer clashes with module_init, and updates Kconfig so the test is built when KUNIT_ALL_TESTS is enabled.

Introduces a helper function that asserts a file range has no ordered extents and integrates it into four existing code paths (fallocate, hole punching, zero range, reflinks) to reduce duplication and add runtime checks.
Updates i915 selftests to replace kthread_stop() with kthread_work API and explicit signaling, because kthread_stop now asserts pending signals and breaks test execution.
Adds command‑line options to the xdpsock BPF sample allowing users to set destination and source MAC addresses for transmit‑only operation, while keeping defaults unchanged.

The commit corrects a printf‑style format string in the AMD XGBE driver: it changes the %hx specifier to %x (or equivalent) so that the promoted int argument from ntohs() matches the format, eliminating a clang -Wformat warning.

The patch modifies the MIPS jump_label compatibility code to cast the upper bound of a branch range to a signed long before comparison, ensuring a correct signed check and preventing warnings from negative offsets.

The patch changes the SPI driver to use per‑CPU u64_stats_t for statistics, removing spin_lock_irqsave around updates. This reduces lock overhead and improves interrupt handling latency from 136 µs to 98 µs on i.MX8MM with MCP2518FD.
Enables the GENERIC0_INT interrupt for graphics/compute pipelines in the amdgpu driver so the RLC can be signaled to access indirect registers that the CP cannot reach directly.

The commit removes the reg field from the r8a73a4_cpg structure because it is only needed during initialization, replaces it with a local variable, and passes that variable to r8a73a4_cpg_register_clock(). This simplifies the data structure and initialization flow.

The patch corrects error handling in the Stratix10 FPGA driver: s10_ops_write_init() previously tested the return of stratix10_svc_allocate_memory() for NULL, but that function returns ERR_PTR on failure. The check is changed to IS_ERR() to properly detect errors.

Adds a workaround for Parade PS8461E eDP MUX: on each link training it re‑reads SUPPORTED_LINK_RATES to restore the MUX's link‑rate state lost during power‑down, preventing fallback to low‑quality mode.
The patch replaces manual swapping of two variables in net2280.c with the standard swap() helper, removing the temporary variables `tmp` and `end`, to silence Coccinelle warnings.
The commit removes the HW_VAR_H2C_FW_P2P_PS_OFFLOAD case from SetHwReg8188EU() and calls the underlying function directly, simplifying the driver and eliminating an unnecessary HAL abstraction.
Adds a bounds check on user‑supplied data->block[0] in ismt_access() to ensure it does not exceed the size of dma_buffer, preventing out‑of‑bounds writes.

The patch initializes the shared flag (head->shared) before nvme_mpath_alloc_disk() so that nvme_is_unique_nsid() correctly reports uniqueness, eliminating block device naming collisions in multipath shared namespaces.
Adds a BPF selftest exercising __user pointer tags, expecting verifier failures, thereby extending the test suite to cover this verification scenario.
The commit updates kernel documentation to state that SAVEKMSG_MAGIC[0‑2] are not magic numbers but delimiters used when dumping dmesg to Chip RAM on Amiga with debug=ram.
Changes tfp410_fini() to return void instead of int (it always returned zero) and updates callers; notes preparation for i2c/platform remove callbacks to become void as well.
Adds a null‑pointer check for the sta_rates structure in mt7615_sta_rate_tbl_update to avoid dereferencing it when minstrel_ht_update_rates fails to allocate the rates array.
Adds a new YAML device‑tree binding file describing the LoongArch CPU interrupt controller, documenting the 14 IRQ lines and their wiring to the platform's internal interrupt controller.

The patch modifies batman-adv's interface traversal to stop assuming iflink indices are globally unique across network namespaces, adding checks for netns and handling special cases like vxcan returning 0.

The patch corrects pinctrl handling for Nuvoton wpcm450 where the SCS3SEL and KBCCSEL MFSEL bits have inverted logic; it updates the driver to treat a 0 as selecting the special function and 1 as GPIO, fixing misconfiguration.

The patch corrects a compile‑time check in the mlx5e kTLS TX path by replacing an incorrect constant with TLS_DRIVER_STATE_SIZE_TX, ensuring the private TX TLS driver context size is compared against the right value.
Adds a const qualifier to the path argument of do_sys_name_to_handle(), making the pointer read‑only and preventing accidental modification.

Replaces dev_err() calls in the Qualcomm QMP UFS PHY probe with dev_err_probe(), which automatically handles -EPROBE_DEFER, prints the error name, and records the defer reason for debugfs, simplifying the probe code.
The commit removes a duplicated word 'we' from comments in the bcache driver, cleaning up redundant wording without altering code logic.

Adds a new GETVXATTR operation to CephFS, allowing clients to query specific directory and file virtual extended attributes directly from the MDS, with JSON layout handling and temporary legacy format support.
Deletes the unused irq_prepare_beacon_tasklet field from the recv_priv struct in the r8188eu driver, cleaning dead code.
Adds handling for an additional GPIO line to independently control the headphone in the Intel SOF ES8336 ASoC driver.
Introduces a Qualcomm display clock controller driver for SM6125 platforms, enabling display subsystems to probe and manage their clocks.
Adds a diagnostic warning in the ACPICA executor when a sleep longer than 10 ms occurs, to highlight potential boot‑time delays.

The patch changes the batman-adv driver’s log output for macvtap devices moved between network namespaces. It lowers the severity of the "Cannot find parent device" message from error to warning and rewrites the text to clarify that the sanity check was simply skipped.
Adds a guard to amdgpu_smu_stb_debug_fs_init to avoid dereferencing a NULL pointer when the SMU block is not enabled, fixing a crash in the AMD GPU driver.

The patch updates the nvme-fc driver to restart the admin queue inside __nvme_fc_abort_outstanding_ios() when the caller indicates it is needed, preventing the controller from becoming unable to handle admin requests and causing I/O hangs.
Introduces SO_RCVMARK socket option so recvmsg() can return the packet's SO_MARK value, and renames sock_recv_ts_and_drops() to sock_recv_cmsgs() for clarity.
Removes the duplicated word 'new' from comments in the rtl8192e staging driver, cleaning up the documentation.
The commit removes the debug-leds driver from the OMAP ARM subsystem because it has been unselectable for years, eliminating dead code from the kernel source.
Corrects underline lengths in Documentation/security/SCTP.rst to remove make htmldocs warnings.

The patch adds the `static` qualifier to symbols in arch/arm64/kernel/cpu_errata.c that are only used within the file, silencing Sparse warnings about undeclared symbols and preventing them from being exported globally.
Stops the driver from disabling SCDC on Pi0‑3 models lacking SCDC by setting the scdc_enabled flag only when HDMI >1.4 is used, preventing invalid register accesses.
The commit updates the lis3lv02d I2C driver to use the newer .probe_new() callback instead of the older .probe(), because the driver’s probe does not need the i2c_device_id argument.
Removes an incorrect interrupt‑flags cell from the MSM display MDSS device‑tree bindings because the provider supplies only a single interrupt cell, correcting the binding specification.

The patch restores correct initialization of the engine workaround list for Gen2‑3 i915 platforms, which was broken by a prior helper‑signature simplification, by always initializing the list (a no‑op when no workarounds exist).
The patch deletes an obsolete comment in btrfs_search_slot() that described a former custom locking scheme, which is no longer used after the switch to rw semaphores.
The commit adds definitions for two new DPCD bit fields required for PSR2 support according to the eDP 1.5 specification, updating the DRM driver to expose these capabilities.
The patch deletes duplicate invocations of ras_late_init within the HDP RAS block of the amdgpu driver, simplifying the initialization flow.
The patch removes an unnecessary cast when assigning the void* result of of_device_get_match_data() to a typed pointer in the PCI j721e driver, as the cast is redundant.
Makes tcp_cdg_release safe to be invoked repeatedly, fixing a double‑free crash that occurs when MPTCP calls tcp_disconnect on an already‑disconnected flow while using CDG congestion control.
The patch modifies the v4l2 control reference code to allocate memory for array members inside struct ctrl_ref, preparing the kernel to let drivers resize those arrays later.

The commit modifies the STM32 DHCOM device tree to use MCO2 as the RMII clock source for the DWMAC Ethernet MAC, replacing the ETHCK_K source. This frees PLL4_P from a 50 MHz limit, allowing higher PLL frequencies, which improves SD/MMC throughput and reduces EMI.

Adds sanity checks in the Qualcomm QMP PCIe PHY driver probe to verify that required configuration masks (pwrdn_ctrl and phy_status) are provided, emitting WARN_ON_ONCE if missing, thus catching misconfigurations early.
Adds a compatible string for the AST2600 EVB A1 board in the Aspeed device tree, allowing the kernel to recognize and support this hardware.
Adds a runtime assertion that clear_em_logging() must be called while holding a write lock on the extent map tree, ensuring proper locking before merging extent map entries during logging.

The patch modifies rcu_tasks_trace_pregp_step() to IPI every CPU, placing the currently running task on the holdout list and recording its RCU Tasks Trace read-side state, ensuring running tasks are accounted for during grace‑period processing.
Updates the BMA400 accelerometer driver macros for minimum and maximum scale values to match the sensor's true sensitivity per LSB for all supported ranges.

The patch corrects the packet extraction logic for the Sparx5 driver so that packets whose length is not a multiple of 4 are processed without erroneously including extra checksum bytes, and ensures the checksum is interpreted in little‑endian host order.
The patch removes an unnecessary comparison in find_va_links() of the vmalloc subsystem, simplifying traversal logic by relying on the invariant that each vmap_area’s start is ≤ end.

Adds a central definition for the 'linux,input-type' property in the dt-bindings input.yaml file and updates all existing bindings to reference this definition, improving consistency of device tree documentation.
The patch changes the declared return type of a Sparx5 network driver function from bool to int, aligning the signature with the actual error‑integer values it returns.
Corrects a spelling mistake in a comment within the selftests/vm/pkeys test suite; no functional code changes.
Switches RCU synchronization code to use call_rcu_hurry() instead of call_rcu(), restoring previous behavior because power‑saving changes in call_rcu slowed down RCU sync.
The commit extends the Qualcomm socinfo driver by adding entries for additional SoCs (SM8350, SC8280XP, SA8540P, SM8450) and related PMICs, enabling the kernel to recognize these platforms.
The patch replaces the multiline macro vt6655_mac_word_reg_bits_on in the vt6655 driver with an equivalent static inline function, because checkpatch.pl rejects multiline macros.
The commit updates the 8250_omap serial driver to use the generic uart_xmit_advance() helper for advancing the transmit queue, aiming for code unification and increased robustness.
The patch deletes calls to bio_advance() in __split_and_process_bio() and __send_duplicate_bios() because a previous change removed the loop that required them, making the code obsolete.
Adds a guest_cpu attribute to perf's hypervisor thread handling, allowing perf to identify which guest CPU (VCPU) a host hypervisor thread is executing.
The patch adds a driver quirk to enable the Synaptics InterTouch (rmi4) touchpad on ThinkPad P1 G3 (and possibly X1 Extreme G3), which was previously disabled by default.
Implements hardware workaround Wa_16013835468 in the i915 DRM driver to handle PSR2 when a display mode has delayed vblank.
Adds the const qualifier to all initialization tables and rtl8xxxu_rfregs in the rtl8xxxu Wi‑Fi driver, making these arrays read‑only; many were already static.
Adds support for multiple subnodes within pinctrl groups for MediaTek mt8195, updating the dt-bindings YAML and providing an example usage.

Adds a runtime check for Xilinx SHA hardware via the firmware get_version API, preventing the driver from probing on unsupported platforms, switches to module_platform_driver macro, and adds a firmware dependency.
The patch refactors the QLA2xxx driver’s EDIF BSG interface: it adds a version field and a version check, and removes dead code and unused fields, preparing for future enhancements.
Fixes a spelling typo in a comment within the RDMA opa_vnic driver.

Adds device‑tree binding definitions for the Qualcomm SM6350 camera clock controller, introducing compatible strings, clock IDs and required properties so the kernel can describe and use this hardware.
The patch expands the rtl8xxxu Wi‑Fi driver’s chip‑cut handling to accept version letters A‑P, replacing the previous fallback that reported "unknown" for cuts beyond E.

The patch separates the handling of HK_FLAG_WQ and HK_FLAG_DOMAIN in the workqueue housekeeping cpumask, giving each its own cpumask and forbidding mixed flag calls, to enable future runtime cpuset modifications.
The commit updates the MAINTAINERS file to change John Garry's email address for arm64 perf tooling, with no code modifications.
The patch deletes an explicit .owner assignment in the Sunplus Ethernet driver because the core network code already sets it, eliminating a warning from the platform_no_drv_owner.cocci check.
The patch adds power‑management support to the Microchip PCI1XXXX SPI driver by implementing suspend and resume callbacks that save the driver configuration on suspend and restore it on resume.
The commit corrects the baud‑rate table for FTDI SIO USB‑serial devices, restoring the proper 300 bps entry that had been mistakenly mapped to 9600 bps for many years.

Adds support in the perf x86 AMD driver for the PERF_SAMPLE_DATA_SRC event by converting IBS raw data into the generic perf_mem_data_src structure, enabling tools like perf mem and c2c to use detailed memory access information.
The patch adds a cleanup path that frees the orom_data buffer allocated with vzmalloc() when ice_read_flash_module() fails, thereby correcting a memory‑leak in ice_get_orom_civd_data().
