Fixes ov5640 driver frame‑rate reporting: previously ov5640_try_frame_interval() assumed a universal 60 fps max, but only VGA mode supports it. The patch uses each mode's max_fps field to initialise maxfps, ensuring correct frame‑rate values are reported to users.
The commit updates the MAINTAINERS file to add Helge Deller as the maintainer for the fbdev subsystem, reflecting a change in responsibility.
The commit fixes whitespace by properly indenting lines in the handle_ctrl_vlan() function of the vdpa/mlx5 driver.
The commit adds code to the SCMI cpufreq driver that detects when power values are expressed in micro‑Watts (as per SCMI v3.1) and converts them before passing to the Energy Model.
Adds a generic notifier_block for VM fork events, exposing register/unregister functions so drivers like WireGuard can be informed when a VM forks; becomes a no‑op when the feature is not compiled.

Removes the Btrfs extent writepage address space callback, which was only used for single‑page writeback from kswapd and caused inefficient random dirty‑page shoot‑down; the code is eliminated to rely on normal background writeback.
The commit deletes a stray comment about an unfinished "arbitrary monitoring target support" feature that was unintentionally introduced in mm/damon due to patch reordering.

The commit renames or adjusts macros for the TRCIDR3 register in the ETM4x coresight driver to follow the sysreg.h naming convention (register name + field name + _MASK), improving code readability without changing generated code.
The patch extracts PAS handling from __mdt_load() into a dedicated helper, removing a boolean flag and simplifying the MDT loader API so callers can invoke PAS directly and manage its metadata.
Adds a Chinese translation of the vm/page_frags.rst documentation file.
The commit changes IPv4 route handling to reject routes whose rtm_tos contains ECN bits, by replacing the fc_tos field with a dscp_t type, ensuring ECN bits no longer affect route matching.
The patch removes the unused 'task' argument from functions invoked via do_arch_prctl_common() on x86, because those functions only operate on the current task, simplifying the API.
The patch removes the EXPORT_SYMBOL for kthread_blkcg, limiting its visibility to the core kernel because it is only used by built‑in blk‑cgroup code.

Adds three regmap_field helper functions (set_bits, clear_bits, test_bits) as static inline or regular functions to simplify simple bit operations that were previously performed via regmap_field_update_bits.
Updates kernel documentation to highlight the count helper functions for fwnode and device property arrays, informing developers about these shortcuts.
Adds extra checks in the AMDGPU driver discovery code to verify table signatures, checksums and existence before access, and temporarily disables the MALL table.
The patch changes several functions in the AMD display driver to static and removes an unused function, eliminating sparse -Wmissing-prototypes warnings.
The patch adds a free() for the fw_control_ex structure when pm8001_chip_fw_flash_update_build() fails, eliminating a memory leak in the pm8001 SCSI driver.
The patch adds a NULL‑pointer check after a kzalloc() call in the SGI‑IP22 MIPS driver, handling allocation failure to avoid dereferencing a NULL pointer.
The patch deletes the HMM_BO_SHARE enum/value from the atomisp driver because the HMM buffer object implementation never supports it, removing dead code.

Adds a guard in drm/v3d job cleanup to avoid dereferencing a NULL BO pointer when v3d_lookup_bos fails; ensures job->bo is non‑NULL before iteration and notes drm_gem_object_put already handles NULL, removing redundant checks.
The commit rewrites the mixel,mipi-dsi-phy device tree binding into a JSON‑schema format, adding assigned‑clocks properties and making power‑domains mandatory, to satisfy dtbs_check.
Adds runtime checks for the IEEE80211_P2P_ATTR_CHANNEL_LIST attribute in the wilc1000 driver to ensure the buffer is large enough for a variable‑sized struct, preventing out‑of‑bounds writes.

The patch corrects the selection of the port used to send VBT packets on Intel dual‑link DSI displays. It changes the code to use the per‑port bitmask in intel_dsi->ports rather than an incorrect mask, ensuring the right physical port is chosen.

The patch modifies the thermal governor code to replace a deprecation warning about the userspace governor with an informational message that suggests using netlink thermal events, because the userspace governor is still required on production systems.
The patch changes the DSI PHY driver to store direct clk_hw pointers instead of formatting parent clock names, simplifying management and reducing lookup overhead.
The patch updates the xdp_bpf2bpf self‑test by removing the deprecated CHECK macro and replacing it with ASSERT* macros, cleaning up the test code.

Adds support to set the color space on the rkisp1 resizer sink pad and, for Bayer pass‑through mode, forces YCbCr encoding to Rec 601 and quantization to full range, propagating the settings unchanged.
The patch deletes the IWL_DEVICE_BZ_COMMON macro and merges its sole usage into the IWL_DEVICE_BZ macro, simplifying the iwlwifi configuration code.
Increases the default memory allocation in torture.sh from 1 GB to 2 GB so that KASAN testing, which requires at least 2 GB, can run successfully.
Adds correct device‑tree compatible strings for SSD130x I2C controllers and deprecates the older “fb”/“-i2c” variants, improving driver matching semantics.
The patch modifies the AMDGPU PSP driver termination code to release allocated memory when the unload operation fails, eliminating a memory leak.
Implements driver logic to recognise different A619 GPU speedbins (SKUs) and configure appropriate frequency ranges for each hardware variant.
Updates the STM32 nvmem driver config to include STM32MP15_BSEC_NUM_LOWER, preparing support for the upcoming STM32MP SoC variant.
Updates mnt_idmapping to replace old non‑type‑safe helper functions with new type‑safe equivalents for mapped filesystem UID/GID handling.
The patch moves a read‑only array used for V4L2 control ranges from stack allocation to a static definition, reducing stack usage and shrinking generated object code.

The commit removes obsolete declarations from the s390 compatibility header (compat_linux.h) that were made redundant by a prior change to use a generic UID16 implementation, and generally tidies up the small header file.
The patch removes an unnecessary include of the deprecated <linux/of_gpio.h> header from Mediatek DRM drivers because the code does not use any symbols from it.
Adds support for the Sunplus SP7021 Ethernet controller by introducing a new driver in the net/ethernet subsystem.
The patch fixes a use‑after‑free in dvb‑core caused by a race between dvb_demux_open and dvb_dmxdev_release by adding an exit‑flag check and protecting the release path with a mutex.
Removes an unintended duplicate definition of tcp_wmem_schedule, fixing a compilation failure caused by the duplicate symbol.
Adds a check for the return value of alloc_workqueue() in nintendo_hid_probe and implements error handling to avoid null dereference.
Adds a reset helper for per‑rmid architecture‑specific storage and calls it when a new rmid is first allocated, clearing hidden state that could otherwise persist beyond the rmid's lifetime.
